title: Open Problems in Geometric Nonlinear Quantum Dynamics
exact_target: Build geometric foundations for nonlinear quantum evolution, its relativistic symmetries, gauge changes, composites and dissipative hydrodynamics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002310 (OWR-12341-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Representations of Lie Groups and Supergroups (2013), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2013/13, pp. 735--799. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 16, 17.
Goldin 2008 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The target consists of all five linked construction questions in the supplied statement. It is a programme, not one uniquely specified conjecture; no particular nonlinear evolution or signaling axiom is imposed beyond what the question asks to investigate. The primary numbered list also begins with a request for a general theory of quasi-invariant measures on spaces of embeddings and immersions, omitted from the abbreviated catalogue paragraph; this is identified as an additional source research direction rather than silently discarded. A quasi-invariant measure and its transforms have the same null sets under the relevant diffeomorphism action.
